facts.fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya took public comments on its proposed rules on mobile line deactivation and number recycling; the document is dated 2026-10-12 and gives no date for the comment period.
facts.system: CA proposed line deactivation and recycling rules

facts.fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya gave a written response to the public comments on the proposed line deactivation and recycling rules, accepting a central recycled-numbers database and rejecting a proposal that subscribers notify contacts by SMS.
facts.system: CA proposed line deactivation and recycling rules
